title: Slovakian Jewelled Fruit Parfait
description: A delicious and healthy dessert made with layers of fruit, jewelled mix, and a touch of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Jewelled Mix
ingredients.notes: any combination of sparkling sugar, edible glitter

ingredients.name: Slovakian Fruit Bowl Mix
ingredients.notes: a mix of dried fruits and nuts

instructions: Prepare the fruit bowl mix according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the plain yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract (if using).
Layer the fruit, jewelled mix, and fruit bowl mix in a parfait glass or a large bowl.
Drizzle the yogurt mixture over the top layer.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with the fruit on top.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, drizzle with a little water to help the dried fruits rehydrate.
